Time-Series Transformers, Patched.zh: 打补丁的时间序列 Transformer

Long-horizon forecasting on an air-quali.zh: 在一个带空气质量风格的信号上做长视界预测，共四种方式：季节性朴素基线、ARIMA 风格、LSTM、PatchTST。滑动补丁长度，观察预测与 RMSE 的变化。探讨 PatchTST 为何最终战胜了 LSTM，以及 Mamba 正把它带向何方。
Long-horizon forecasting on an air-quali.src:
Long-horizon forecasting on an air-quality-flavoured signal,
          four ways: seasonal-naive baseline, ARIMA-flavour, LSTM,
          PatchTST. Slide the patch length, watch the forecast and
          RMSE change. Why PatchTST finally beat the LSTMs and where
          Mamba is taking it next.

@@T0@@约 20 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@时间序列 · 预测 · Transformer@@T3@@

What's hard about time-series forecastin.zh: 时间序列预测难在哪里？

Three things make time series harder tha.zh: 有三件事使时间序列比常规机器学习问题更难：
Three things make time series harder tha.src:
Three things make time series harder than a regular ML
          problem:

@@T0@@Multiple seasonalities.@@T1@@ Dail.zh: @@T0@@多重季节性。@@T1@@ 日、周、年——有时全部叠加在同一个信号中。
@@T0@@Multiple seasonalities.@@T1@@ Dail.src: Multiple seasonalities. Daily, weekly, yearly — sometimes all in one signal.

@@T0@@Distribution drift.@@T1@@ A sensor.zh: @@T0@@分布漂移。@@T1@@ 传感器的均值与方差随时间变化。昨天的训练分布并不是今天的测试分布。
@@T0@@Distribution drift.@@T1@@ A sensor.src: Distribution drift. A sensor's mean and variance shift over time. Yesterday's training distribution isn't today's test distribution.

@@T0@@Long horizons.@@T1@@ Predicting th.zh: @@T0@@长视界。@@T1@@ 预测下一个点很容易。从 96 个点的上下文预测未来 96 个点，才是大多数方法崩解之处。
@@T0@@Long horizons.@@T1@@ Predicting th.src: Long horizons. Predicting the next point is easy. Predicting 96 points ahead from a 96-point context is where most methods fall apart.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@ Almost every tim.zh: @@T0@@这句口号。@@T1@@ 你在 2020-2022 年间读到的几乎每一个时间序列结果，都被季节性朴素方法击败。PatchTST（2023）是第一个在各项基准上从容胜出的深度模型——其架构只有约 50 行：把序列切成 ViT 风格的补丁，再在补丁词元上运行 transformer。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@ Almost every tim.src: The slogan. Almost every time-series result you read in 2020-2022 was beaten by seasonal-naive. PatchTST (2023) was the first deep model to comfortably win across benchmarks — with a 50-line architecture: cut the sequence into ViT-style patches and run a transformer on the patch tokens.

The four baselines you owe yourself.src: The four baselines you owe yourself

@@T0@@Seasonal-naive.@@T1@@ Predict $\\h.zh: @@T0@@季节性朴素。@@T1@@ 预测 $\hat y_{t+h} = y_{t + h - S}$，其中 $S$ 为季节周期（24 小时、7 天）。它是只有一行的基线，却有 30% 的时间能击败深度模型。
@@T0@@Seasonal-naive.@@T1@@ Predict $\\h.src: Seasonal-naive. Predict $\hat y_{t+h} = y_{t + h - S}$ where $S$ is the seasonal period (24 hours, 7 days). It's a one-line baseline and beats the deep models 30% of the time.

@@T0@@ARIMA / ETS.@@T1@@ Classical stati.zh: @@T0@@ARIMA / ETS。@@T1@@ 带有显式趋势 / 季节性 / 自回归项的经典统计模型。在平滑、行为良好的信号上表现强劲。
@@T0@@ARIMA / ETS.@@T1@@ Classical stati.src: ARIMA / ETS. Classical statistical models with explicit trend / seasonality / autoregressive terms. Strong on smooth, well-behaved signals.

@@T0@@LSTM / GRU.@@T1@@ Recurrent networ.zh: @@T0@@LSTM / GRU。@@T1@@ 循环网络。称霸十年；最终在长视界上被打补丁的 transformer 超越。
@@T0@@LSTM / GRU.@@T1@@ Recurrent networ.src: LSTM / GRU. Recurrent networks. Decade of dominance; finally outperformed on long horizons by patched transformers.

@@T0@@PatchTST.@@T1@@ Treat the sequence.zh: @@T0@@PatchTST。@@T1@@ 像视觉 Transformer 处理图像那样处理序列：切成互不重叠的补丁，为每个补丁做嵌入，在补丁词元上运行普通的 transformer，再投影回预测视界。
@@T0@@PatchTST.@@T1@@ Treat the sequence.src: PatchTST. Treat the sequence the way a Vision Transformer treats an image: split into non-overlapping patches, embed each patch, run a vanilla transformer over the patch tokens, project back to the forecast horizon.

The earlier wave of time-series transfor.zh: 更早一波时间序列 transformer（Informer、Autoformer、FEDformer）把每个时间步当作一个词元。在长上下文下，这会让模型淹没在词元之中，$O(N^2)$ 的开销随之膨胀。PatchTST 把每 $P$ 个连续点归为一个词元（正如 ViT 对图像用 $P \times P$ 的补丁），使词元数减少 $P\times$，并让模型对局部结构获得略为平滑的视角。
The earlier wave of time-series transfor.src:
The earlier wave of time-series transformers (Informer,
          Autoformer, FEDformer) treated each timestep as a token. At
          long context lengths this drowns the model in tokens and the
          $O(N^2)$ cost balloons. PatchTST groups every $P$
          consecutive points into one token (just like ViT does with
          $P \times P$ patches of an image), reducing token count by
          $P\times$ and giving the model a slightly smoother view of
          local structure.

That's it. Patch length $P$ is the only.zh: 就是这样。补丁长度 $P$ 是唯一真正新增的超参数。通道独立性（用同一个共享 transformer 预测每个通道，从而不必把多变量强行塞进一个巨大的词表）是第二个技巧。第三个——对每条序列做实例归一化——则处理分布漂移。
That's it. Patch length $P$ is the only.src:
That's it. Patch length $P$ is the only real new
          hyperparameter. Channel-independence (predict each channel
          with the same shared transformer, so multivariate isn't
          forced into a giant vocabulary) is the second trick. The
          third — instance normalisation per series —
          handles distribution drift.

The PatchTST tokenisation. Sequence → pa.zh: PatchTST 的词元化。序列 → 补丁 → 嵌入 → transformer → 预测头。
The PatchTST tokenisation. Sequence → pa.src: The PatchTST tokenisation. Sequence → patches → embeddings → transformer → forecast head.

Channel independence — the unintuitive c.zh: 通道独立性——反直觉的选择

PatchTST predicts each variate $v$ using.zh: PatchTST 用同一个共享 transformer 预测每个变量 $v$，直至最终投影之前都不做跨变量注意力。理由如下：
PatchTST predicts each variate $v$ using.src: PatchTST predicts each variate $v$ using the same shared transformer, with no cross-variate attention until a final projection. Reasoning:

@@T0@@Overfitting protection.@@T1@@ Cros.zh: @@T0@@防止过拟合。@@T1@@ 跨变量注意力每层有 $V^2$ 个参数；在 $V \sim 10$ 个变量、训练窗口只有数千个的基准中，它会急剧过拟合。
@@T0@@Overfitting protection.@@T1@@ Cros.src: Overfitting protection. Cross-variate attention has $V^2$ parameters per layer; in benchmarks with $V \sim 10$ variates and a few thousand training windows, it overfits aggressively.

@@T0@@Transferability.@@T1@@ A channel-i.zh: @@T0@@可迁移性。@@T1@@ 通道无关的模型可以在变量数不同的序列上训练（一个模型，多个任务）。这正是基础模型式预训练得以实现的关键。
@@T0@@Transferability.@@T1@@ A channel-i.src: Transferability. A channel-independent model can train on series with different variate counts (one model, many tasks). This is what enables foundation-style pretraining.

@@T0@@The trade-off.@@T1@@ You lose the.zh: @@T0@@权衡。@@T1@@ 你会失去学习“通道 A 领先通道 B 三个步长”这一关系的能力。当这种跨通道信号很重要时，应改用 @@T2@@iTransformer@@T3@@（每个变量 = 一个词元，注意力作用在变量而非时间之上）。
@@T0@@The trade-off.@@T1@@ You lose the.src: The trade-off. You lose the ability to learn that "channel A leads channel B by 3 steps". When that cross-channel signal matters, use iTransformer (each variate = one token, attention is over variates not over time).

Empirically the two cover different regi.zh: 经验上二者覆盖不同情形：PatchTST 在时间步很多、接近单变量的面板上胜出；iTransformer 则在跨变量结构占主导时胜出。
Empirically the two cover different regi.src: Empirically the two cover different regimes: PatchTST wins on univariate-ish panels with many time steps; iTransformer wins when cross-variate structure dominates.

RevIN — the instance normalisation that.zh: RevIN——修复分布漂移的实例归一化
RevIN — the instance normalisation that.src: RevIN — the instance normalisation that fixes distribution drift

A time series usually has a non-stationa.zh: 时间序列通常具有非平稳的均值与方差。经典的解决办法是差分或对数变换；PatchTST 的现代解法是@@T0@@可逆实例归一化@@T1@@（Kim 等人，2022）：
A time series usually has a non-stationa.src: A time series usually has a non-stationary mean and variance. The classical fix is differencing or log-transforming; PatchTST's modern fix is Reversible Instance Normalization (Kim et al., 2022):

Standardise the input window using its o.zh: 用输入窗口自身的均值/方差对它做标准化。在归一化后的序列上运行模型。再用同一组统计量把预测反归一化。只需三行代码；在基准划分上稳定带来 1–2% 的视界 RMSE 改善。对于达到“十年一遇图表”级别质量的结果至关重要。
Standardise the input window using its o.src: Standardise the input window using its own mean/variance. Run the model on the normalised series. Un-normalise the forecast with the same statistics. Three lines of code; consistently +1–2% horizon-RMSE improvement on benchmark splits. Critical for chartof-the-decade-quality results.

Below: a synthetic AQ-flavour signal (da.zh: 下面是一条合成的空气质量风格信号（日 + 周 + 噪声 + 缓慢漂移）。滑动视界与补丁长度；四个模型都会给出预测，RMSE 随之更新。

Context (left) | true (faint, right) | f.zh: 上下文（左侧）| 真值（右侧，淡色）| 四条叠加的预测曲线。竖线标记预测的起点。
Context (left) | true (faint, right) | f.src: Context (left) | true (faint, right) | four overlaid forecasts. The vertical line marks the forecast start.

@@T0@@State-space models (Mamba, S5).@@T.zh: @@T0@@状态空间模型（Mamba、S5）。@@T1@@ 带结构化状态空间递推的线性注意力。在极长上下文上快得多；在预测任务中与 PatchTST 互有胜负，并且在长视界上越来越常取胜。
@@T0@@State-space models (Mamba, S5).@@T.src: State-space models (Mamba, S5). Linear attention with a structured state-space recursion. Much faster on very long contexts; for forecasting they trade blows with PatchTST and increasingly win on long horizons.

@@T0@@iTransformer.@@T1@@ Treats each @@.zh: @@T0@@iTransformer。@@T1@@ 把每个@@T2@@变量@@T3@@（而非每个时间步）当作一个词元，因此 transformer 的注意力学习的是跨序列结构（哪些其他传感器预测哪些）。在多变量面板上表现强劲。
@@T0@@iTransformer.@@T1@@ Treats each @@.src: iTransformer. Treats each variate as a token rather than each timestep, so the transformer attention learns cross-series structure (which other sensors predict which). Strong on multivariate panels.

@@T0@@Foundation models for time series..zh:
@@T0@@面向时间序列的基础模型。@@T1@@
            TimesFM（Google）、Chronos（Amazon）、Lag-Llama、Moirai——这些大型预训练模型可对新时间序列任务做零样本或单样本处理。当你拥有许多短序列、却没有逐序列微调预算时，它们很有用。
@@T0@@Foundation models for time series..src: Foundation models for time series. TimesFM (Google), Chronos (Amazon), Lag-Llama, Moirai — big pretrained models that zero-shot or one-shot a new time-series task. Useful when you have many short series with no per-series fine-tune budget.

@@T0@@Forecast distributions.@@T1@@ Quan.zh: @@T0@@预测分布。@@T1@@ 分位数回归头、共形校准、带归一化流的 deep AR——该领域已从“预测一个数字”转向“预测一个区间”。@@T2@@贝叶斯优化@@T3@@与@@T4@@贝叶斯推演场@@T5@@的文章在此处很有用。
@@T0@@Forecast distributions.@@T1@@ Quan.src: Forecast distributions. Quantile regression heads, conformal calibration, deep AR with normalising flows — the field has moved from "predict a number" to "predict an interval". The BO and Bayesian playground articles are useful here.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n T.zh:
@@T0@@最后总结。@@T1@@
          时间序列预测不再是“深度学习败给季节性朴素”这样的笑柄。PatchTST 与 Mamba 以适度的算力让长视界预测变得实用，而基础模型则彻底改变了数据预算的等式。这是任何预测技术栈在 2026 年最实用的更新。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n T.src: Final takeaway. Time-series forecasting is no longer a "deep learning lost to seasonal-naive" punchline. PatchTST and Mamba make long-horizon forecasting practical with modest compute, and foundation models change the data-budget equation entirely. The most practical 2026 update to any forecasting stack.

How to set up a forecasting evaluation t.zh: 如何搭建一个不说谎的预测评估
How to set up a forecasting evaluation t.src: How to set up a forecasting evaluation that doesn't lie

@@T0@@Backtesting, not random splits.@@T.zh: @@T0@@回溯检验，而非随机划分。@@T1@@ 使用滚动起点评估：训练至时刻 $t$，预测 $[t+1, t+H]$，再推进 $t$。沿时间做随机划分会泄露信息。
@@T0@@Backtesting, not random splits.@@T.src: Backtesting, not random splits. Use rolling-origin evaluation: train up to time $t$, forecast $[t+1, t+H]$, advance $t$. Random splits over time leak information.

@@T0@@Multiple metrics.@@T1@@ Report MSE.zh: @@T0@@多个指标。@@T1@@ 报告 MSE 与 MAE（对离群值的敏感性不同），再加上一个无量纲指标（sMAPE 或 MASE），以便跨数据集汇总。
@@T0@@Multiple metrics.@@T1@@ Report MSE.src: Multiple metrics. Report MSE and MAE (different sensitivity to outliers), plus a scale-free metric (sMAPE or MASE) so you can aggregate across datasets.

@@T0@@Compare against the seasonal-naive.zh: @@T0@@与季节性朴素方法比较。@@T1@@ 永远都要比。一个胜不过 $\hat y_{t+h} = y_{t+h-S}$ 的模型根本算不上预测模型。
@@T0@@Compare against the seasonal-naive.src: Compare against the seasonal-naive. Always. A model that doesn't beat $\hat y_{t+h} = y_{t+h-S}$ isn't a forecasting model.

@@T0@@Interval coverage, not just point.zh: @@T0@@区间覆盖率，而非仅点预测。@@T1@@ 报告 90% 置信区间的覆盖率与宽度——一个 30% 情况下都落空的紧区间，比一个能命中 90% 的较宽区间更糟。用@@T2@@共形预测@@T3@@包裹以获得廉价的无分布区间。
@@T0@@Interval coverage, not just point.src: Interval coverage, not just point forecast. Report 90%-CI coverage and width — a tight interval that misses 30% of the time is worse than a wider one that hits 90%. Wrap with conformal prediction for cheap distribution-free intervals.

@@T0@@Long horizon = horizon ≥ context.@.zh: @@T0@@长视界 = 视界 ≥ 上下文。@@T1@@ 标准基准（ETT、Weather、Traffic、ECL）都评估 H ∈ {96, 192, 336, 720}。比这更短的就是另一个问题了。
@@T0@@Long horizon = horizon ≥ context.@.src: Long horizon = horizon ≥ context. The standard benchmarks (ETT, Weather, Traffic, ECL) all evaluate H ∈ {96, 192, 336, 720}. Anything shorter is a different problem.

@@T0@@Nie, Nguyen, Sinthong, Kalagnanam.zh: @@T0@@Nie, Nguyen, Sinthong, Kalagnanam (2023)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers.@@T3@@ 即 PatchTST 论文。
@@T0@@Nie, Nguyen, Sinthong, Kalagnanam.src: Nie, Nguyen, Sinthong, Kalagnanam (2023) — A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers. The PatchTST paper.

@@T0@@Hyndman &amp; Athanasopoulos@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@Hyndman 与 Athanasopoulos@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Forecasting: Principles and Practice.@@T3@@ 经典的基线与方法参考书。
@@T0@@Hyndman &amp; Athanasopoulos@@T1@@.src: Hyndman & Athanasopoulos — Forecasting: Principles and Practice. The classical baseline-and-method reference.

meta.title: 打补丁的时间序列 Transformer
meta.tagline: 为何 PatchTST 把序列切成 ViT 风格的补丁，并最终战胜了 LSTM
meta.summary: 在一个空气质量风格的信号上并排进行长视界预测：季节性朴素基线、ARIMA、一个小型 LSTM，以及 PatchTST。滑动补丁长度，观察预测如何变化。文章结尾讨论状态空间模型（Mamba）所处的位置及其后续发展。
highlights: 实时生成合成的空气质量风格信号（日 + 周 + 噪声 + 漂移）；基线、类 ARIMA、类 LSTM 与类 PatchTST 的预测曲线叠加呈现。
滑动补丁长度与视界，观察四个模型的 RMSE 如何更新。
带位置编码的补丁词元化示意图，使 transformer 一侧变得具体。
与实验室对齐：AirDelhi 移动传感器、JoulesEye / ApneaEye 呼吸频率、能量分解。
